text:
violet (design): Quick thread: propose a tiny one-line latency toolbar to give more vertical room to the heatmap. Presets: 10s / 1m / 5m / 30m. Custom opens a modal. Sampling as a collapsed chip that expands to a micro-slider. Mock: figma.link/short omar (frontend): Compact is great. Two notes: (1) indicate when sampling is non-default (dot or percent), (2) expand should be overlay to avoid layout shift. mina (eng): Backend: sampling changes aggregation; include sampling_pct in URL and debounce slider at 200ms. Also log preset vs custom usage via telemetry. dan (pm): Product: default sampling 20%. Must keep p95 visible at all times. We'll track preset clicks to pick better defaults. lee (a11y): Accessibility items: presets keyboard-focusable, sampling pill exposes aria-expanded/controls, slider has aria-valuetext like "Sampling: 20%", and chart updates announced with aria-live polite. Also bump contrast on tiny legend chips in dark theme. violet (design): Copy for sampling tooltip: "Sampling reduces processing/storage; may hide short spikes." Short and concrete. omar (frontend): Sketch:
[10s][1m][5m][30m]
p95: 110ms
mina (eng): Agreed; server will compute p95 on range change and cache 1s. We'll accept `?sampling_pct=20` and event `latency_sampling_change`. lee (a11y): Also ensure tooltip is dismissible with Esc and that low-density state (<=5%) shows an overlay badge "low sampling expect noise" and patterning for colorblindness. dan (pm): Decision: ship v1 with compact toolbar, collapsed sampling chip (default 20%), pinned p95, URL + telemetry hooks. Follow-ups: a11y checklist from lee, prototype from omar, backend query support from mina. ci-bot: CI: branch feature/latency-toolbar created by omar at 1978010105 omar (frontend): I'll prototype the chip + overlay by Friday. violet (design): Thanks team will bring mocks and copy to UX sync. :white_check_mark:
